item.title: Streamerr’s commitment to Hospital Radio
item.description: Hospital radio stations are the heartbeat of healthcare facilities across the UK. They provide vital emotional support, entertainment, and a connection to the outside world for patients during their recovery journey. Run entirely by dedicated volunteers, stations broadcast requests, dedications, news, and comfort to thousands of patients daily—making a real difference when it matters most. […]
